svg.title: NUGGS welfare-source decision map
svg.desc: A vector summary separating verified primary text, NUGGS engineering rules, and unresolved claims.
svg.text: NUGGS — DTSchB source decision map
Tierschutzwidriges Zubehör (June 2024), verified against the committed 12-page PDF
VERIFIED PRIMARY TEXT — PDF PAGES 7–8
“Kunststoffröhren” are acceptable only when all three conditions hold:
≤ 2 × animal body length AND adequate ventilation AND instructions against misuse
“nur dann akzeptabel” + “höchstens” makes this a conjunctive acceptance limit.
SOURCE SCOPE RESOLVED
“Kunststoffröhren” is the subject of all
three conditions. No summed system-length
formula appears anywhere in the paper.
Conclusion: per tube, not a total-system sum.
NOT ESTABLISHED BY THIS PAPER
• NUGGS RUN and break definitions
• treatment of couplings or connected tubes
• any 7 cm / 70 mm entrance or bore rule
TVT MB 62 is listed as a source but remains unread.
PRODUCT-MANAGER ACTION
Remove N2 “scope PROVISIONAL”; keep length joined to ventilation and instructions.
Keep the stricter NUGGS per-run cap; label run and break definitions engineering judgement.
Do not cite this paper for N1’s 70 mm floor; retrieve the separate primary brochure.
Repository source: docs/nuggs-sources/tierschutzwidriges-zubehoer.md
